instruction: In the Pictures directory, create a subfolder named 'mountains' and move all three picture files into it.

metadata.explanation: Task requires creating 'mountains' subfolder and moving all 3 pictures into it. Evaluator verifies the subfolder contains all 3 image hashes (picture1: ec076282..., picture2: 6ed4239ecc..., picture3: 79f45d40d8...).

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts SHA256 hashes of all images in the target subfolder /home/user/Pictures/mountains
Metric correctly performs set comparison between result hashes and expected hashes, handling both missing and extra files
Complete coverage: Evaluator verifies subfolder exists (implicit - empty list if missing), all 3 pictures are present (via hash matching), and no extra files exist
Correct parameter handling: Metric function correctly accesses expected.get('expected_hashes') since expected IS the rules dict when type='rule'
SHA256 hash verification ensures the exact picture files were moved to the subfolder (content-based verification)
Edge cases handled: missing subfolder returns empty list (fails verification), wrong files have different hashes (fails verification), partial moves detected via missing hashes
